title: RaceSystem
description: RaceSystem includes 7 races: Human, Shark, Bird, Rabbit, Undead, Demon, and Giant. Each race gives unique abilities like flight, underwater buffs, speed boosts, combat bonuses, or increased health and damage, while Human has no special abilities.
body:
🧬 RaceSystem

RaceSystem is a Minecraft plugin that adds a race-based progression system where every player belongs to a unique race with special abilities. Players start as Human and can reroll into new races using in-game currency or reroll tokens.

✨ Features
🧍 Start as Human (default race)
🎲 Reroll into random races using /reroll
💰 Buy rerolls using in-game money (Vault supported)
🔄 Reset your race anytime with /removerace
🎮 GUI-based race menu and reroll shop
⚙️ Admin tools to manage player races and rerolls
🧬 Races

Each race provides unique abilities:

🧍 Human — Default race, no bonuses
🦈 Shark — Extra health, underwater speed, breathes underwater
🐦 Bird — Flight ability, fast gliding movement
🐇 Rabbit — Faster movement and higher jumps
☠️ Undead — Night buffs, sunlight weakness, bonus damage at night
🔥 Demon — Fire/lava immunity, Nether power boosts
🧌 Giant — Increased size, health, and damage (but higher hunger use)
🎮 Commands
Player Commands
/race — Open race information menu
/reroll — Open reroll shop (buy or use rerolls)
/removerace — Reset back to Human
Admin Commands
/racemanage — Open admin overview GUI
/racemanage <player> — View a player’s race
/racemanage <player> set <race> — Set a player’s race
/racemanage <player> givereroll <amount> — Give rerolls
/racemanage <player> takereroll <amount> — Remove rerolls
/racemanage <player> setreroll <amount> — Set reroll balance
/racemanage <player> nextreroll <race> — Force next reroll outcome
